design.holdout: IDs divisible by three reserved before tuning; both supplied trimaps remain with their image; candidate unchanged after holdout scoring
design.input: Original native PNGs, decoder checked byte-for-byte against independent Pillow RGBA; grayscale trimap levels explicitly mapped into alpha assets

design.baseline: Previous IC(0) with proportional Smooth versus the same solver after in-place sparse row packing and optional-factor allocation recovery. Equations, constraints, tolerance, iteration ceiling and estimated graph capacity remain unchanged.
design.convergence: Same original Laplacian, exact hard labels, maximum 2000 iterations, actual relative residual <=1e-7; failures never approximate-success
design.memory: Previous estimated 444-byte reserved-row base retained; optional IC(0) adds 200 bytes/row when it fits within 192 MiB; otherwise global Jacobi
design.timing: Individual overlapping container observations, not controlled speed comparisons, p95/input-to-photon, hardware GPU or peak-heap measurements

baseline.metricDefinition:
Local alpha-quality measurements; no official leaderboard compatibility claim.

All alpha values are normalized to [0,1]. Score only the official unknown mask.
Gradient = squared difference of Gaussian-derivative vector fields, sigma 1.4,
nearest-edge extension, scipy truncate=4, sum/1000. Connectivity independently
propagates thresholds 1,0.9,...,0 through prediction and reference from the largest
common exactly opaque component; phi=1-(alpha-level) when alpha-level>=0.15,
lambda=1, absolute phi differences sum/1000. No common opaque source => undefined.
These are explicitly defined local measures inspired by Rhemann et al. CVPR09;
they are not certified replacements for the website/MATLAB implementation.

pairedPerformanceFigure.source:
import json
from pathlib import Path
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
from matplotlib import pyplot as plt
root=Path('/tmp/canoli-matting-conditioning');d=json.loads((root/'paired-summary.json').read_text());fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(10,5),layout='constrained')
for ax,key,title,median in zip(axes,['solveMs','elapsedMs'],['Global solve','Native decode / solve / PNG pipeline'],['medianSolveMs','medianPipelineMs']):
 a=[s['case'][key]/1000 for s in d['runs']['baseline']['samples']];b=[s['case'][key]/1000 for s in d['runs']['candidate']['samples']]
 for old,new in zip(a,b):ax.plot([0,1],[old,new],color='#a1aaa4',linewidth=1)
 ax.scatter([0]*len(a),a,color='#6d7871',s=45,zorder=3);ax.scatter([1]*len(b),b,color='#42674e',s=45,zorder=3);ax.set_xticks([0,1],['Previous sparse rows','Packed sparse rows']);ax.set(ylim=(0,max(a+b)*1.18),xlim=(-.3,1.3),ylabel='Seconds',title=title);ax.spines[['top','right']].set_visible(False)
 old=d['runs']['baseline'][median]/1000;new=d['runs']['candidate'][median]/1000;ax.text(.5,.93,f'Median {old:.1f} → {new:.1f} s',ha='center',transform=ax.transAxes)
fig.suptitle('Canoli Studio — sparse matting iteration cost\nGT04-Trimap2: 218,709 unknown pixels; byte-identical output',fontsize=14)
fig.supxlabel('Three sequential paired Node runs on the same container. Same matrix, tolerance, memory budget and 797 iterations.\nSingle-case evidence; not browser, p95, input-to-photon, hardware-GPU or peak-memory results.',fontsize=9)
fig.savefig('docs/benchmarks/matting-sparse-performance-2026-10-16.png',dpi=160)
